reasoning: The three corner brackets with a bottom-right plus sign represent a screen capture selection box, viewfinder, or crop/scan area. It works well for tasks centered on taking screenshots, scanning documents, or cropping images, though at small sizes it looks very similar to generic fullscreen or expand UI icons.

pass1.ambiguity: Can be confused with a plain fullscreen/expand icon, a camera viewfinder, or a generic UI selection tool.
